question: The pH of milk of magnesia is about _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **10.4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milk of magnesia**

 
 
• The chemical compound **Mg (OH)₂ **is also known as milk of magnesia, **magnesium dihydroxide, or magnesium hydroxide**.
 
• The** mineral brucite** is known to naturally contain this chemical compound. Milk of magnesia is known to exist as a **white solid with a very low solubility in water **under typical temperature and pressure conditions.
 
• It is essential to keep in mind that certain** laxatives and antacids** contain milk of magnesia.
 
• Milk of magnesia is sold as** chewable pills**, capsules, powder, and liquid suspensions for medical use, frequently **flavored.**
 
• Milk of Magnesia is frequently sold as an antacid to **neutralize stomach acid** and alleviate indigestion and heartburn.
 
• Additionally, it is a laxative that can **alleviate constipation**. As a laxative, magnesia's osmotic force draws fluids from the body.
 
• High doses can cause diarrhea and deplete the body's potassium supply, which can frequently cause **muscle cramps.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Properties of Milk of Magnesia**

 
 
• Mg (OH)₂ can be used to represent milk of magnesia's chemical formula.
 
• This chemical compound has a **molar mass** of** 58.3197 grams per mole.**
 
• This compound is a white solid that **does not have any distinctive odor **under typical conditions.
 
• Under standard temperature and pressure conditions (STP), milk of magnesia has a **density of 2.3446 grams per cubic centimeter.**
 
• This compound has an approximate melting point of **350 degrees Celsius**. Nevertheless, it is essential to keep in mind that this compound begins to decompose at this temperature gradient.
